title: The noflo port-behavior catalog
description: The core-owned noflo.* node-metadata keys for per-instance port-behavior overrides (work document #44): the knobs tweak Process API semantics, and no other namespace may re-declare them. Consumed at runtime by @noflo/noflo's applyPortMetadata (the subset a running network can check) and at publish time by the gate (the namespace reservation and the opt-in composition, work documents #37/#25).

schema.description: The instance's complete gate-inport set, replacing the component's declared control ports: a listed name is a gate (standing, non-consumingly-read configuration whose arrivals re-fire pending work per scope), an unlisted former gate becomes a direct firing edge. Addressable inports cannot be gates.

Inport-name to boolean: whether IPs on the port participate in scope identity. Outports are not overridable (the outport-side flip interacts with the ordered-output and forwarding machinery and needs its own design pass).

Inport to outports array, the same shape as the component's forwardBrackets option: an instance entry replaces the component's declared rule for that inport, unlisted inports keep their declared or built-in rules, and the empty array is the framing-termination declaration.
